sehly_master_phone_components.name: Brand header
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Center x=.50W, y=.064H; 10px tracked label (4.5px tracking) at 390 width. Exact supplied NOJARA mark in reserved top zone, clearspace 0.5x mark height.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Chapter eyebrow
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Center x=.50W, y=.115H; 9px / 1.8px tracking; muted gold (#D4AF37 / #8C6A45). One chapter label, no dense navigation.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Hero headline
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: x=24, width=342 (W-48); top .15H; 28px / 31.4px line-height (Jaapokki Subtract); center aligned; 2 lines preferred, 3 maximum.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Supporting line
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: 14px / 20px (Inter); secondary color (#D0DCE3); 8px beneath headline; max width 310px.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Sphere stage
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Idle center (.50W, .52H), projected diameter .78W (304.2px at 390W); allow camera-led overscan for discover/enter. Reframe using measured stage, never stretch mesh.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Voice capsule
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Idle centered at .88H; 220-256px wide, 48-56px high; microphone 24px visual, >=44px target. Reserve safe-area bottom plus 16px.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Listening state rings
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Teal concentric rings (#9AFFE0 / #78D3B2), radii 24/30/38 CSS px; level-driven scale 1.00-1.04 (attack 80ms, release 240ms); show Listening and Stop/mute controls with explicit semantics.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Selected target card
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Panel x=24, width=W-48 (342px), y=.74H proposed; 20px radius; 16px padding; target label and Open action. Move capsule below with >=16px gap.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Detail panel
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Same glass family; heading + Overview / Explore rows, each >=44px. Panel may overlay empty sphere area but must not obscure face, title, or selected content.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Media portal
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: World-anchored circular/elliptical rim; fit source with aspect-ratio preserved (contain default; 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, portrait). Fixed aperture dimensions across content swaps.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Focus marker
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Gold point with 2px ring at 390 CSS px; 44px invisible hit target. Leader line and short label appear only when needed.

sehly_master_phone_components.name: Final composition
sehly_master_phone_components.spec: Same sphere family; larger negative space; title CEREBRO and One continuous intelligence. Hold copy >=3s. Exact NOJARA lockup required for production.
